title: Replacement System Installations Rebate Program Figures and Multi-System Discount Rates
content:
# Manufacturer rebate and multi-system discount figures

Two package-level figures govern credits on a Replacement System Installations contract: the manufacturer's seasonal rebate (with the installation dates that qualify for it) and the multi-system discount rate on an additional system.

| Package | Manufacturer seasonal rebate | Qualifying installation dates | Multi-system discount (percent of that contract's price) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison Essential Series System | $0.00 (no rebate) | None | 5 |
| Harbison Advantage Series System | $0.00 (no rebate) | None | 5 |
| Harbison Performance Series System | $400.00 | 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30 | 5 |
| Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System | $600.00 | 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30 | 5 |
| Harbison Signature Series System | $800.00 | 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30 | 5 |
| Harbison Signature Elite Communicating System | $1200.00 | 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30 | 5 |

## Reading the table

- A rebate of $0.00 with qualifying dates "None" marks a package that carries no seasonal rebate.
- The qualifying dates are written first day to last day.
- The multi-system discount rate is 5 percent on every package and is a percentage of the price of the contract that receives it.

## Figures at a glance (hypothetical contracts)

- A hypothetical Harbison Signature Series System contract shows a seasonal rebate of $800.00 against the 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30 dates.
- A hypothetical additional system priced at $10695.00 shows a 5 percent multi-system discount of $534.75.
